const IC="",FV="";
const png=b=>new Response(Uint8Array.from(atob(b),c=>c.charCodeAt(0)),{headers:{'content-type':'image/png','cache-control':'public,max-age=86400'}});
export default {async fetch(req){const u=new URL(req.url);
if(u.hostname.startsWith('www.'))return Response.redirect('https://'+u.hostname.slice(4)+u.pathname+u.search,301);
if(u.pathname==='/icon.png')return png(IC);
if(u.pathname==='/favicon.png'||u.pathname==='/favicon.ico')return png(FV);
return new Response(HTML,{headers:{'content-type':'text/html;charset=utf-8','cache-control':'public,max-age=300'}});}};
